title: Three Shifts and One Short Rope
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：qualification　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 qualification 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the foreman ① earned the qualification that no worker in the site would have counted, and he said the earning was the whole of the shift. The ② qualification, meaning the certificate itself and not the rope, ran three shifts and stayed uncounted in the book; a qualification, he said, is the only thing in a site that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ qualification in that site had the same short rope beside it, and the ④ qualification at the far ramp, meaning the load they kept for the children to lift and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A qualification, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the foreman said the counting is the part that fills three shifts.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the qualification was the whole of the matter, meaning the ability and not the certificate. The ⑥ qualification, meaning the ability and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; qualification, he said, is either something you earn or the only word that means both a certificate and an ability. He said the ability is the part they remember.

By 1996 the ⑦ qualification had become a line in a sheet, and the sheet had become an argument about the short rope. The ⑧ qualification of the whole thing, the foreman wrote in May, was one site and three shifts of counting; qualification, he said, is either the load at the far ramp or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ qualification I remember is the certificate counted in the sheet, which closed in 1998 and is still counted as the quietest in the site. A ⑩ qualification, my mother said in 2000, is the only certificate that improves by being counted; every qualification, she said, is an ability that has agreed to look like a certificate. She said the ability was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 资格；资历（指工地里每一项旁边的那一项）
B. n. 资格；资历（指那项资格本身，与短短的绳索相对）
C. 固定搭配：earn the qualification 取得这一项资格
D. n. 资格；资历（指留给孩子们抬的那一车）
E. n. 资格之事（抽象总称，指一处工地的资格之事）
F. n. 资格；资历（指施工单里写到、被清点的那一项）
G. n. 资格、本事（指一件事里人人都干却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 本事（抽象总称，指人人都干却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: earned the qualification that no worker in the site would have counted
The qualification, meaning the certificate itself and not the rope
the qualification at the far ramp
the qualification was the whole of the matter
the qualification had become a line in a sheet
The qualification of the whole thing
A qualification, my mother said in 2000

answers.why: earn the qualification 意为“取得这一项资格”，1991 年那位工头把工地里没有一位工人肯清点的一项资格做了一遍。
qualification 意为“资格；资历”，指那项资格本身而不是短短的绳索，它经过了三个班次而在簿子上没有被清点。
qualification 意为“资格；资历”，指工地里每一项旁边的那一项，每一项旁边都有同一根短短的绳索。
qualification 意为“资格；资历”，指最远那道坡台的留给孩子们抬的那一车，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
qualification 意为“资格、本事”，指一件事里人人都干却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这项本事就是那件事的全部。
qualification 意为“本事”，指人人都干却无人提起的那样东西而不是那项资格，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
qualification 意为“资格；资历”，指施工单里写到、被清点的那一项，到 1996 年这一项成了施工单里的一行。
qualification 意为“资格之事”，工头五月写道，整件事的资格之事是一处工地和三个班次的清点。
qualification 意为“资格；资历”，我记得的是施工单里清点过的那一项，1998 年收工了，至今仍被说成工地里最安静的一项。
qualification 为抽象总称，母亲 2000 年说，资格是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的资格。
